description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the EncounterRoleValidator class in the OpenMRS project. It tests validation logic for EncounterRole objects, including name null/empty checks, duplication prevention, proper editing, field length validation, and successful validation scenarios.

classes.name: EncounterRoleValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for EncounterRoleValidator, extending BaseContextSensitiveTest for integration with OpenMRS context.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheNameOfTheEncounterRoleIsNullEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that validation fails if the EncounterRole name is null, empty, or whitespace.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfEncounterRoleNameIsDuplicate
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when a duplicate EncounterRole name is used.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassEditingEncounterRoleName
methods.description: Tests that editing an existing EncounterRole with a valid, non-duplicate name passes validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation passes when all field lengths are within acceptable limits.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests that validation fails when field lengths exceed maximum allowed limits.
